- evidence_id: chem-ont-chebi-17439
  kind: authority
  reference: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/17439/
  locator: record identity, definition, formula and source component/preparation fields
  support: context_only
  summary: The20 B12 occurrences do not have a single demonstrated vitamer scope.
    Four explicit MediaDive compound1238 solution nodes identify cyanocobalamin and
    can be source-scoped to CHEBI17439. The TOGO records say B12/Cobalamin, while
    CHEBI176843 is a vitamer class containing multiple compounds. Existing mutual
    REJECTED_LABEL decisions must survive; do not add a universal B12 alias to Cyanocobalamin
    or use its CAS to choose all occurrences.
  snapshot_sha256: ac9e13f3c5473e9870c905bb6313519dd8d36b8d5d82197273085466142fa667
  accessed_at: '2026-11-08T05:09:49.763892Z'

- evidence_id: chem-ont-chebi-17905
  kind: authority
  reference: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/17905/
  locator: record identity, definition, formula and source component/preparation fields
  support: context_only
  summary: The source explicitly parenthesizes mercaptoethanesulfonic acid after Co-enzyme
    M, as a5g solute in a separate100X stock; the alias denotes only that solute.
    ChEBI17905 defines that acid with formula C2H6O3S2, whereas sodium mesna and coenzyme
    M anion are different scopes. The existing owner uses17905 despite its historical
    -sulfonate display label, so this exact acid spelling can be linked without moving
    identity.
